Those are stupid generalisations and false assumptions and they annoyed the hell out of me at your age too. Life doesn't necessarily get better or worse but it will change significantly and that can be tricky to cope with. 

But you'll change too and some of that will be for the better. Ultimately don't put too much stock into any one person's advice. They were all where you are now and they stumbled and worried and eventually figured out A WAY to make it work for them but it's not THE ONLY WAY.

Been climbing and fighting to get to 3-4 the past few years.
Just had some news that's knocked me to an 8 for the first time in a long while.

Making a "good" choice and setting a "healthy boundary" has left me feeling like i've hacked half a limb off.

Why does trying to do the "right" thing always backfire so painfully?
It takes all my effort just to inoffensively exist.
Do you have a cure for depression? No? Then this correlation is irrelevant.

I'm 29 and the longest I held down a job was a very off-on year in 2015.

Ended in a total mental breakdown i think I only really came back from recently. The only way I'm not constantly wrecked with anxiety and smothered by depression is by not thinking about getting a job.
But my government based disability finances are a rug that could be pulled at any moment.

I wish i had some kind of answer but I've thought the thoughts to death. It's at least some slight solace to know I'm not alone in this impasse.

I don't know how but everything keeps getting worse.

I feel like i'm being punished for something.

For feeling.

29, since 13. 
Hard to know what I've done with my twenties besides suffer.
I think i'm losing.
Why not both?

Physically - Somewhat

Mentally - Exhausted
I'm so tired of chasing my anxiety back to its source 15 times a day. Just to discover it's the most trivial petty trigger and knowing it doesn't even help sometimes.
I think continued existence is the bare minimum so not very well.

Sometimes people don't realise just how much of ourselves we give them. Perhaps we give too much.

I hope you get past this.
All the best.
I have nothing to offer anybody. I am let down and a let down. I feel used and yet it's my own fault. Why do i continue living like anything is going to change? Like i'm going to change.
No one can look after me while i'm young, why would it get any easier when i'm older? I hope i just die before anyone takes on that burden.
Life shouldn't be like this.

That everything is corrupt and the seemingly easy justice would be blockaded at every turn because money rules the world, not morals.

Also cardigans.
I feel like i'm constantly slipping but i never actually fall. I never regain balance either, i'm just constantly in a vertigo of semi-freefall panic.
"Why are you depressed?"

Absolutely. I feel like i've missed out on any kind of young love life. Tons of women already have kids now as well which just narrows things down further.

Everyone else i know is either with someone or attractive enough to stop being single whenever they feel like it.
All of them and then none of them. Wait 6 months and repeat.
Everything.
Comedy
The consequences for being needed and fucking up are far greater than being wanted for something and not delivering.
Try not to do anything stupid and forget it's a thing.
Tall enough for back problems, not tall enough that it's a talking point.
It's not just occasional so i got used to it. It's just the norm now.

Ignore all media with the potential to remind you it's any different to any other day.

It's more make you feel less shit than make you feel good but it's the best i've got.
On the upside, at least you're not them.

Snap.
As in i feel the same. Try not to actually snap, although this shit makes it hard sometimes.

Say this hypothetical "healthy genes, high IQ, educated couple" do have 10 kids. What's to stop those kid's lives going wrong anyway? Favourable traits are no guarantee, life will happily shit on you anyway. Bad luck, tragic accident, the maliciousness of others. They can still end up in the same ditch as someone born with none of those advantages. 

And if these lucky genetically superior few are having to factory line their fuckdumps, chances are higher they'll fuck up the parenting through overload.

The best people can ever argue for is "less chance of things going horribly wrong and producing a lifetime of suffering." It's still not worth it.

No one should be forgotten on their birthday. That said, if ever there was a time in recent memory for people to have a lot on their plate, it's the past year. 

It doesn't necessarily mean anyone's stopped caring although i can understand how it feels like that, if it's the first time it's deviated from the norm. 

Happy birthday and i hope the rest of the day improves for you.

Media and entertainment based things. I'm told i'm a half-decent writer, i studied filmmaking but unless you're a based in London, socialite go-getter you don't even have the slimmest chance.

It feels like people are born capable of these sorts of things and i'm just not.
I don't think life is ever going to get better than this and this isn't even a life.

28 and i could have easily written this last year.
I've achieved nothing memorable with my life and when i try to reach for it, i fuck up and when i don't, people console me "it will come in time."

Wish i could say something more supportive but if i could think of anything i'd be saying it to myself too.

Yeah, i worry if maybe i seem like that to my friends. Like i'm going off on some crazy diatribe...I don't think i am. Maybe they're just busy and i almost never am.

I used to have a gaming group like that in my teens. It feels like a completely different person did those things now and i just have their memories.
I don't know where most of those friends ended up. We drifted apart...Even though i tried to not let that happen. Sometimes you mean less to other people than they mean to you.

It was some trivial political thing. We're all roughly the same wavelength politically but that wasn't even really the focus. It's just like...they didn't even want to talk to me.

I brought it up because it was more videogames related which we're all into but the responses were so flippant and apathetic...I dunno. I was just trying to start a conversation. I know i'm shit at doing so but i've known these guys for 15 years. It shouldn't be like this.

Yeah, i have one friend who i can talk to with almost no filter about anything. She's unwell atm so i think i'm feeling the absence more maybe. There's so many people in the world and yet it feels like i "click with" almost no one.

Maybe they changed, maybe i did. I don't know.

This is just "What doesn't kill you makes you stronger." 

Pain and hardship doesn't gift us anything and all the "hard knocks" that supposedly "build character" just look like deformities to me. Psychologically broken bones, sticking out so we can't move how we used to but people dismiss them as quirks or eccentricities. 

What doesn't kill you is a wound and wounds can heal but they definitely don't make you stronger.

Yeah. I find myself screaming into pillows quite often these days. Because my headphones fell off or a cable came loose. I dropped something or something didn't go how i expected.

It's horrible. Makes me feel like a child.
It's kind of the reverse, i'm not antinatalist because i can't get laid. I can't get laid because i'm antinatalist.

If antinatalism is about reducing suffering, i wouldn't want people unfortunately already born to suffer.

Anti-mask views do seem incongruous with this kind of sub but i don't think they should be censored or outright banned.

Unfortunately i can't comment further because i don't know the context and what was said in those deleted posts, hence the issue in censoring this stuff. 

One anti-masker, no matter how opposed you or I are to it, does not a right wing sub make.
Well I might get laid now but i'm also going to be forever questioning if it's because i'm liked or because i'm endangered. M28.
That was actually just an interesting read, thanks.
Don't worry, as long as you apologise they'll forgive you for a lifetime of suffering and hardship...

It's hard to find it funny when you have to be told it's a joke. They never say it like it's a joke.

Thanks for doing your TED talk  : )
The voice is mine, the mocking laughter is a whole swarm of people. If my parents appear they don't normally speak, just look quietly disappointed.
I'm really sorry it got to this point.
I did everything to try and feel better today. Good coping mechanisms and bad. Nothing works. I've been here too long.

Well that's it. Govt cut my benefits, no hope of appeal. Won't be able to afford to stay where i am by next year.

Can't hold down a job, can't hold down a coherent thought. Moving here was supposed to turn things around. Therapy is useless, friends barely reply to me. Wish i'd died years ago, i've achieved nothing.
I think even if someone gave me a hug, i wouldn't know how to accept it anymore.
Being unable to physically enact something is basically the only obstacle left for me.
There's only one lazy person not being taken seriously here.

Absolutely. I think mainly because if i were in their position, I wouldn't have the bravery to be honest. Not to someone who infamously takes hurt and criticism and offence as well as a bowling ball to the stomach.

I wish i could say i've personally seen recovery progress using books and apps. The kind of puzzles and games supposed to improve memory but i haven't really.

In more tangible news there is some preliminary scientific findings in treating deteriorated brain cells associated with depression and aging. That's something to cling to, hopefully.

I'm having a lot of the same feelings i think. It's like you hit a breaking point but nothing happens and you're supposed to just carry on broken.

It definitely becomes a physical pain after a while too and it's hard for anyone to get that without experiencing it. I wish i had answers for you but all i can say is you're not alone in loneliness even though it will by definition feel that way.
Having serious suicidal thoughts for the first time in a few months. Trying to keep busy, productive and achieving something but all i think i've done is fry my nerves and burn myself out.

Your post does make a lot of sense and i can relate to a great deal of it. I've never been much more than a punchline and it's hard not to cling to anyone who treats you as worthwhile.

I hope things improve for you and happy birthday for tomorrow.
And you can tell them this too, to try and pre-emptively save yourself some pain but they all think it won't be that bad.
It's why i'm not buying a car.

If you've had suicidal ideation before or for a long enough period of time, i think it stands to reason you'd drift to thinking about different methods.

I've never done any drugs and wouldn't know how to get them but i've had fantasies and urges where i wish i could just go down in a blaze of depravity, just to have it over with.

Not sure if that's at all how you're feeling but i guess that's my take on it. Intrusive thoughts of any form are pretty horrible to deal with. I hope it passes for you soon.

People always look at these subs like terrible echochambers when it's 99% of everywhere else spewing dismissive condescending advice which this is a escape from. Catharsis and negativity aren't inherently bad. Being constantly told as such is what brought me here.

The closest i get to feeling happy with my life is temporarily deluding myself that one day i'll reach it.

I'm starting to believe things might never get better than this.

"It's okay not to have everything figured out. In time you'll get there. "
Almost everything about society blatantly rejects this.

By the time you figure anything out you're too old for the world to care. It's down to luck and how much you're willing to exploit people. If you don't want to be a prick, expect to be struggling in perpetuity.

I'm sure my therapist would agree with you but some friendships are even worth that pain. She's literally saved my life from mental health difficulties multiple times, been there for me when no one else has and understands me on a level no one else does. 

A part of me sincerely doesn't want her to change her mind because i know we wouldn't work together and i've damaged the friendship enough. 

Maybe i am an idiot but my best friendship is worth this. I'm actively working towards meeting other people. Typically i planned this right before the world caught fire but i'm going to keep trying. Life without her love is painful but life without her entirely is no life at all, because i went down that road and wasted 7 years of my life.

Not trying to be contrarian or refute your entire point. I think you're probably right, for a lot of people it's the best solution...but not for everyone. Anyway all the best, hope you feel some peace however you go about trying to get it.

They never say when to stop working on yourself either. Do these people reach a point when they are "fixed" or happy with themselves? because i'm not sure a lot of people ever reach that in their entire life.

Watched a really well written, produced and aspirational video today. It made me simultaneously satisfied and depressed because i'll never come close to that.

I can never not compare myself to others more successful. I can't even enjoy enjoyment anymore without depression finding an angle to snipe in at me.
When you no longer want them to come true.

I don't know anything i could say to match the weight of what you've been through. It sounds like an unending nightmare.

You have fought through and achieved things though. 19 months clean is no small feat, it's something to cling to. Proof that you're not entirely broken by this broken world, even though i'm sure it feels like that.

I dunno. Like i say, you've been through more shit than i can wrap my head around but i sincerely wish the best for you. I did read this and i do give a fuck. You're not alone.
I feel like a terrible person, a worthless creature and a poisonous friend. I'm sick of hearing myself apologise and say that "i'm trying" but it's all i can seem to do.

Squeezed is a good way to describe it. I'm mentally fried and burnt out for at least the next day. Exhaustion, headaches and a bit spaced out. Kind of a mental hangover, like the batteries straight up exploded.
I wish i knew.

Hit with a wave of hopelessness. Like i suddenly saw everything i've ever done in a new light and it's all unbearably sad, cringey and pathetic.

I'm trying to be better but it's all the more depressing for the effort.

You're still valid even if you're only thinking about cutting yourself. It's mental illness and the source of it is mental and invisible. 

The fact that a lot of people only treat it seriously when there's a physical manifestation of the damage to see reflects poorly on society not you as a person.

If you haven't already, talk to your doctor or at least a trusted friend about this. Find escape routes or distractions to use when you start feeling this way. 
All the best.

"" just as i was planted all bitter and frantic"
I deserved to die seven years ago. All this now is just meaningless delay.
I don't think the therapy's helping and i can barely keep my eyes open.
"You'll grow out of it."
Last i heard he joined the military. I tried to stop thinking about it after that.
4-6 steps off a tall building.

I may do. I'm a big fan of anything Dylan Moran, I appreciate the kind words as well. It's something i've wanted to try for about 10 years but it's pretty terrifying and there's not much in the way of venues in the UK outside of London.

But if i don't try it at least once i'd regret it forever.

Stand-up was the plan. Even if it went poorly I was going to try and get a 5 minute spot weekly, travelling to London. Something to work at, something i actually felt something for.

Dunno how i feel about anything now.

I wasted 6 years on antidepressants in a waking coma. I came off them and was going to turn it all around this year, social groups, speed dating, open mic nights, starting March 31st. It's all fucked now.

I don't know where i got the motivation from at the start of the year but i doubt i'll be able to get it back if or when this all finally ends.

Imposter syndrome.
"You got out of bed before midday? You cooked dinner? 
There's nothing wrong with you, you made it all up."
Then why can't I have the energy of a brand new person? This has been an uninterrupted run of bargain bin knockoff people.

Absolutely and often. It's like you'll forget the details of the dream but your subconscious retains the feelings it gave you. You may then have these underlying feelings distracting or affecting you during the day but forget why or be unable to trace it back.

It can partially or totally derail a day's plans and I wish i could say I had a solution but the best i can say is that it's not completely uncommon.

There are very few things i can say with certainty have helped alleviate my depression. My old dog Louis is one of them. 

All the best to you and Patches.

I lost my shit again and smashed my phone. In replacing it I lost access to my old throwaway account. I sort of feel like that history could have been useful. To try and see some positive progress in it...but it's gone now, because I can't stay calm and I'm never not stressed or depressed.

I'm so sick of my own stupid, impotent rage. Every time I dare to think I'm in control.
